name: Hara Poko! ~Inou Saimin de Jogakuen o Haramase Seifuku~
original_name: 孕ら・ポコ！～異能催眠で女学園を孕ませ征服～
source:
Conquer the girls' school by impregnating them with hypnosis!

"Hahaha! I will conquer this girls' school!"

Ryuuma Uobishi, a teacher at an all-girls school, heard a rumor that claimed that if you performed a certain ritual in the school clock tower at midnight, a god would appear and grant your wish.

Although he thought it was ridiculous, Ryuuma performed the ritual out of curiosity...and it worked.

With his new "supernatural ability", Ryuuma begins to carry out his secret desire of "conquering the school by impregnating his female students!''

translation:
用催眠让女子学校里的女孩怀孕，征服这所学校吧！

“哈哈哈！我要征服这所女子学校！”

在女子学校任教的鱼菱龙马听说了一个传闻：如果午夜在学校钟楼举行某种仪式，神明就会现身并实现愿望。

龙马虽然觉得荒唐，却出于好奇举行了仪式……结果竟然成功了。

凭借新获得的“超自然能力”，龙马开始实现自己隐秘的愿望——“让女学生怀孕，征服整所学校！”
